text: Over the past 30 days, some visitors have expressed frustration with crowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as excessive and detracting from the historical content, with some noting that the technology did not accommodate all visitors comfortably. Others felt the library lacked sufficient depth in presenting Theodore Roosevelt’s accomplishments and impact, missing an introductory film and more substantial interpretation. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and architecture, concerns about historical balance and educational value were raised. Parking and food services were mentioned but less frequently.

A few reviews touched on dwell time, staff interactions, and the conservation message, while food and beverage options were noted only once.
